chunks: God is sufficient for me, and I am content with Him.

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: When God, the Mighty and Majestic, created Adam (peace be upon him) and breathed into him from His spirit, the first thing he spoke of among the creatures was: 'There is no god but God.'

key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: There is no god but God (declaration of monotheism)

ai.seo_question: What was the first thing Adam said after God breathed His spirit into him?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrating that Adam’s (peace be upon him) first utterance upon receiving the divine spirit was 'La ilaha illallah', establishing Tawhid as the primordial essence of human consciousness. This narration underscores the Shia theological view that monotheism is not merely a learned doctrine but an innate disposition (fitrah) embedded in the soul at the moment of creation.
